title: Thai-Cambodian troops clash in early morning gunfire at Chong Bok border
summary: The Nation, citing a Thai border security source, reported that the Chong Bok clash began at 5:45 a.m. on 28 May 2025 and lasted about 10 minutes. The initial report said there were no casualties.

title: Thai and Cambodian armies agree to seek peaceful solutions at disputed border after deadly clash
summary: Associated Press reported that the brief May 28 border clash killed one Cambodian soldier and that Thai Army Chief Gen. Pana Claewplodtook met Cambodian counterpart Gen. Mao Sophan at a border checkpoint on May 29. AP preserved conflicting Thai and Cambodian accounts of who initiated the clash.
